Whitefield, Bangalore
Notice period: 60 days

Professional Summary
Senior financial professional with strong expertise in Financial Modeling and FP&A, experienced in driving budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis within large organizations. Proficient in IFRS reporting, SAP FICO implementations and leveraging Confluence and Jira in Agile environments to streamline financial processes and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

Technical Skills
Financial Modeling, FP&A, IFRS, SAP FICO, Confluence, Jira, Agile

Work Experience

Senior Financial Analyst, Wipro (Sep 2020 - Present)
- Built and maintained detailed Financial Modeling for quarterly forecasting cycles, improving forecast accuracy by introducing driver-based assumptions and scenario analysis; collaborated with FP&A partners to align on monthly reforecasts.
- Led FP&A deliverables for a $120M service line, preparing monthly P&L variance analysis and presenting actionable recommendations to senior leadership that reduced operating cost overruns by 8%.
- Implemented Confluence pages and Jira workflows to document financial processes and track FP&A tasks, reducing cycle time for month-end consolidation by two days.
- Partnered with IT and SAP FICO team to validate ledger mappings and assist in reconciliation efforts during a chart-of-accounts harmonization project.

FP&A Manager, Cognizant (May 2019 - Aug 2020)
- Managed FP&A for a multi-geography portfolio, driving budgeting and monthly close activities and preparing IFRS-compliant management packs for the executive committee.
- Oversaw SAP FICO configuration reviews and testing for finance process changes, ensuring timely recognition and correct posting that improved month-end close efficiency.
- Created Financial Modeling tools to support acquisition integration scenarios and sensitivity analysis used in executive decision-making.
- Coordinated cross-functional teams using Confluence and Jira within an Agile cadence to track deliverables and resolve blockers for reporting deadlines.

Education
B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore
